biotools.summary: Offline, deterministic bioinformatics command-line tool for auditing protein FASTA sequences and PDB coordinate files. Analyzes amino-acid composition and ambiguous residues in FASTA files, and inventories observed C-alpha residues in the first PDB model. Produces structured JSON reports with source SHA-256 digests and bounded quality warnings. Supports reproducible execution and CWL workflow integration. Does not predict protein structures, assess folding accuracy, or validate molecular geometry.

credit.name: Xuanyi Jiang
credit.note: Designed and implemented a deterministic command-line audit for protein FASTA and PDB files, including amino-acid composition analysis, ambiguous-residue reporting, first-model C-alpha residue inventory, source SHA-256 reporting, bounded quality warnings, and reproducibility-oriented testing and documentation

documentation.note: Installation, ls-bio protein-fasta and protein-pdb commands, supported inputs, bounded JSON outputs, 8 MB input limit, CWL wrappers and stated limitations

function.note: Computes counts and source digests; flags uncertain codes without inferring function or sequence correctness.
Counts only observed C-alpha residues in the first PDB model; not a geometry or fold quality assessment.

biotools.name: Life Science Protein File Audit

publication.note: Software archive (Zenodo concept DOI) for citing the tool; not a peer-reviewed article
